body:
Friday: I mended three work shirts from the seed trial. White powder shook from every cuff; my hands blistered before anyone closed the road.

The clerk wanted a cleaner version. I kept the stained one because it showed which part had been changed after the road closed.

There may be a simple reason for the change. Nobody at the next stop could tell us what to do with the first version.
title: Hemmed cuffs from the trial field
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.
